  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ;; Predicates describing the world state
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)          ; ?x is on ?y
    (on-table ?x)      ; ?x is directly on the table
    (clear ?x)         ; nothing is on ?x
    (holding ?x)       ; the robot arm is holding ?x
    (arm-empty)        ; the robot arm is empty
    (moved ?x)         ; ?x has been moved at least once (used for the additional constraint)
  )
  ;; Action: pick up a block from the table
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (moved ?b))
  )
  ;; Action: put down a held block onto the table
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b)))
  )
  ;; Action: stack a held block onto another clear block
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (moved ?b))
  )

                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (moved ?b))
  )
  ;; The additional constraint is enforced in the problem goal using the (moved) predicate.

    (arm-empty)

                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (within-limit))) ;;; activates the limit

  ;; PUTDOWN: place the held block on the table (limit must already be active)
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (within-limit))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))))

                 (arm-empty)
